column11: the programme is finished and did not meet its endpoint. VIOLETTE (NCT03330847, 273 participants) tested olaparib plus ceralasertib and olaparib plus adavosertib against olaparib alone in metastatic triple-negative breast cancer. Its posted registry results give median progression-free survival per stratum of 7.3 months on olaparib alone against 7.4 months with ceralasertib, hazard ratio 1.02 (90% CI 0.63 to 1.66), P=0.9403, and 3.8 months with adavosertib, hazard ratio 1.01 (90% CI 0.52 to 1.88), P=0.9282. The adavosertib arm was stopped early for unacceptable toxicity. Published in Clin Cancer Res, doi:10.1158/1078-0432.CCR-26-1066. No filing followed in the six years since primary completion on 2020-11-13

DUO-E met its endpoint on the olaparib-containing arm - progression-free survival HR 0.55 (95% CI 0.43 to 0.69, P<.0001) overall and HR 0.57 (95% CI 0.44 to 0.73) in the mismatch-repair-proficient subgroup, published J Clin Oncol, doi:10.1200/JCO.23.02132 - and the FDA nevertheless approved only the durvalumab arm from the same study, on 2024-06-14. AstraZeneca took the durvalumab-plus-olaparib combination to Europe instead, where CHMP gave a positive opinion in July 2024.
